verses.1: And these are the sons of the land that were brought back from exile. They were brought back by Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon. They returned to Jerusalem and Judea, with each man going to his own city.
verses.2: Those who came with Zerubavel were Yeshua, Nehemiah, Sharaya, Releiyah, Mardochai. They were from the people of Israel. They showed compassion and kindness to those in need.
verses.3: The sons of Pharaohsh were one hundred seventy-two.
verses.4: The sons of Shephtiyah were three hundred and twenty-two.
verses.5: The sons of Arah were seventy, with five hundred and seventy in total.
verses.6: Bnei Pachat Moav, sons of Yeshua. Yoav Alfiim, two hundred and fifty.
verses.7: The sons of Eleazar were eight thousand, four hundred and thirty.
verses.8: The sons of Zathua were eighty-four and forty-five.
verses.9: The sons of Zakhai were seventy-six in number.
verses.10: The sons of Beni are sixty-four and two.
verses.11: The sons of Beria were sixty and three.
verses.12: The sons of Azgad were eight thousand, four hundred and twenty-two.
verses.13: The sons of Adonikam were sixty-six in number.
verses.14: The sons of Bagoi were five hundred and sixty.
verses.15: The sons of Adin were four hundred and forty-four.
verses.16: The sons of Atzer Lihizkiya are ninety-seven in number.
verses.17: The sons of Betzai were three hundred and thirty-three.
verses.18: The sons of Yorah were one hundred and twenty.
verses.19: The sons of Chashum were forty-three in number.
verses.20: The sons of Givar were fifty-five in number.
verses.21: The sons of Beth-Laham were one hundred and thirty-three.
verses.22: The people of Netophah were fifty-six in number.
verses.23: There were a hundred and thirty people who asked questions.
verses.24: The sons of Azmaveth were forty-two in number.
verses.25: The sons of Kiriath were seven thousand, and forty-three.
verses.26: The sons of Ramah and Gaba were sixty-one.
verses.27: There were about one hundred and twenty people.
verses.28: The people of Bethel were forty in number.
verses.29: The sons of Nebo were fifty-two in number.
verses.30: The sons of Magbishe were one hundred, fifty-six.
verses.31: The sons of Eilam were eight thousand and forty-four.
verses.32: The sons of Harim were three thousand and one hundred.
verses.33: The sons of Lod were Hadid and Ono; they numbered seventy-two.
verses.34: The sons of Jericho were three hundred and forty-five.
verses.35: The sons of Senaah were three thousand and sixty-six.
verses.36: The priests, sons of Jedaya, were from the house of Yeshua. There were fifty-seven of them.
verses.37: The sons of Immer were eight hundred and fifty-two.
verses.38: The sons of Pashhur were eight hundred and forty-seven.
verses.39: The sons of Harim were one thousand seventy-one.
verses.40: The sons of Jesus and Kadmiyal were seventy-four in number.
verses.41: The leaders were sons of Asaf, a total of one hundred and thirty.
verses.42: The sons of Shaul, the sons of Zerubbabel, the sons of Azur, the sons of Talmon, the sons of Acub, the sons of Hattitai, and the sons of Shobai. All of them were one hundred thirty-nine in number.
verses.43: The sons of Zichah, the sons of Chashupha, the sons of Tavathot.
verses.44: The sons of Keros, the sons of Siaha, and the sons of Padoon.
verses.45: Bnei Levana, Bnei Hagava, Bnei Akuv.
verses.46: Bnei Hagav, Bnei Shalmai, Bnei Hanan.
verses.47: Children of Gidel, children of Gachar, children of Raya.
verses.49: Bnei Uzah, Bnei Paseh, Bnei Besai.
verses.50: The sons of Asna, the sons of Meunim, the sons of Nefusim.
verses.51: The sons of Bakbuk, the sons of Chakupa, and the sons of Harhur.
verses.52: Children of darkness, children of evil, children of sin.
verses.53: The sons of Barcos, the sons of Sisra, and the sons of Tamach.
verses.54: The sons of Nitzah were the sons of Hattipa.
verses.55: The sons of Solomon’s servants, the sons of Sotai, the sons of the scribe, and the sons of Purah.
verses.56: Bnei Ya’ela, Bnei Drakon, Bnei Gidel.
verses.57: The sons of Shephtiyah, the sons of Chathil, the sons of Pocheret, the sons of Tzvayim, and the sons of Ami.
verses.58: All the donors and the sons of Solomon’s servants were seventy-two in number.
verses.59: And these people who come from the salt flats of Tel Harashah… They couldn’t tell the names of their ancestors and their descendants, if they were indeed from Israel.
verses.60: Bnei-Delaya, Bnei-Toviya, and Bnei-Nekoda – six hundred and twenty.
verses.61: And the sons of the priests were the sons of Haborah, the sons of Kox, and the sons of Barzilai. He took them from the descendants of Barzilai, Gilad. He named them after him.
verses.62: They sought their written records, but they could not be found. So they were disappointed in the priest.
verses.63: And Tirshatah said to them, “Those who have not eaten from the holy foods until they stand before the priests and the high priests.”
verses.64: All the crowd together is four times twenty-five hundred, three times sixty.
verses.65: In addition to their servants and maids, there are also those who number seventy thousand. They are divided into thirty-six groups. And they have rulers and administrators among them.
verses.66: Their oxen were seventy, with thirty-six separate herds. There were also forty-four sheep.
verses.67: Their armor consists of four hundred, thirty-five, and fifty-six thousand and seventy-two hundred and forty.
verses.68: And from the leaders of the fathers, when they entered the house of Jehovah that was in Jerusalem, they offered sacrifices to the house of God, so that He might sit upon His throne.
verses.69: By their power, they were given to those who performed this work: gold worth six thousand pieces, and silver worth five thousand pieces. There were also twenty priests who served as officials in this matter.
verses.70: And the priests, the Levites, and all the people, along with the rulers, the judges, and those who distributed food, all gathered in their cities. And all of Israel also gathered in their cities.
